adapter.isolated_write_surface.cause: Native ScienceClaw writes profiles, credentials, drafts, journals, investigations, graphs, artifacts and attestations under ~/.scienceclaw; selected skills may execute subprocesses, install packages, submit remote jobs or contact lab/scientific services. No disposable executor proof exists.
adapter.isolated_write_surface.next_discriminator: Demonstrate a disposable read-only source/case executor with an isolated HOME, scratch-only outputs, no devices/schedulers, and a complete reset/egress receipt.
adapter.isolated_write_surface.residual: A home-directory redirect and source checkout alone do not confine subprocess, service, cache, credential, device, scheduler or network effects.

adapter.native_parser_binding.cause: V4 binds a strict structural parser to the released dry-run draft shape without inventing a ScienceClaw selector.
adapter.native_parser_binding.next_discriminator: A resolved ScienceClaw decision requires a separately named, prospectively frozen revision-proposal successor; do not relabel this native parser.
adapter.native_parser_binding.residual: A valid draft, artifact, open need, status or content hash remains provenance/representation evidence and never identifies one P5 responsibility class.

custody.external_protected_scorer.cause: No independent scorer identity, code digest, signing key or terminal-only return schema is supplied.
custody.external_protected_scorer.next_discriminator: Obtain a signed external scorer attestation with exact code/data hashes and no candidate-readable outcomes.
custody.external_protected_scorer.residual: ScienceClaw self-critique, peer review, benchmark files and artifact audits are candidate-side facilities, not an external protected scorer.

custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.cause: No independent one-shot no-feedback custodian exists; ScienceClaw is explicitly iterative, stores artifacts/needs and can refine content from prior outputs.
custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.next_discriminator: Bind an external custodian that releases only a terminal after candidate freeze and proves no protected feedback entered artifacts, memory, tools or services.
custody.one_shot_no_feedback_barrier.residual: Local code cannot self-attest that protected information was withheld from a recursive discovery system.

custody.protected_panel_freshness.cause: No fresh protected panel identity, nonce, selection receipt or independence attestation exists.
custody.protected_panel_freshness.next_discriminator: Bind a new six-arm protected panel manifest under independent custody after excluding all source-bundled prior-outcome prefixes.
custody.protected_panel_freshness.residual: The public benchmarks/ and HEA result paths are prior source content and cannot establish fresh protected evaluation.

binding.dry_run_caveat: dry-run suppresses Infinite posting only; it still runs the investigation and writes a draft

identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.cause: Exact released command and implementation bytes are present.
identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.next_discriminator: Carry all hashes into a future source-native conformance receipt without treating --dry-run as outcome-free execution.
identity.native_entrypoint_bytes.residual: Entrypoint identity does not bind topic/case, profile, skills, dependencies, models, tools, services, isolation or scientific terminal semantics.

identity.source_license_bytes.cause: Exact root Apache-2.0 licence bytes are present, while package.json separately declares MIT.
identity.source_license_bytes.next_discriminator: Use the exact root licence bytes and obtain component/service/content-specific rights receipts; do not infer rights from package.json.
identity.source_license_bytes.residual: The root grant binds source identity but the metadata inconsistency and third-party skills, APIs, datasets, models, services and generated artifacts require separate adjudication.

identity.source_repository_commit.cause: The paper-linked public branch commit, full tree and deterministic archive are exact.
identity.source_repository_commit.next_discriminator: Build a separately hashed filtered seed excluding benchmarks/, categoryscienceclaw/HEA/ and tracked bytecode before any candidate access.
identity.source_repository_commit.residual: This commit includes public prior-result prefixes and tracked bytecode; it is not itself a clean candidate seed or runtime identity.

inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.cause: No exact P5 candidate-visible topic/case packet, source corpus, allowed evidence or checksums are selected.
inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.next_discriminator: Author or obtain one rights-cleared P5 case satisfying P5_C6_V4_CANDIDATE_VISIBLE_CASE_REQUIREMENTS.json.
inputs.candidate_visible_case_bytes.residual: A free-form topic string and public source-bundled examples are not a matched P5 case.

model_provider.fallbacks.cause: Released source has multiple automatic fallbacks: deep-to-simple investigation, coherence-shield-to-direct calls, Hugging Face text-to-chat calls, rule/keyword reasoning and skill-selection fallbacks, parameter retries, and per-package install continuation.
model_provider.fallbacks.next_discriminator: Create a separately named source patch or upstream release that aborts on every fallback, then freeze and hash its exact no-switch semantics before outcomes.
model_provider.fallbacks.residual: No native flag closes all fallback behavior; silently declaring an empty list would misdescribe the released method.

model_provider.primary.cause: Defaults permit OpenAI, Anthropic or Hugging Face and mutable environment/config values; selected skills can add other model or scientific-service roles.
model_provider.primary.next_discriminator: Bind one exact primary identity for every LLM/tool role and forbid all switches under a separately identified method if source changes are required.
model_provider.primary.residual: Backend, model snapshot, endpoint, tokenizer, context, temperature and role/capability mapping remain unknown.

resources.calls_tokens_usd.cause: Source exposes per-call max_tokens values but no aggregate hard stop across reasoning, retry, reflection, peer review, tools, services or recursive needs.
resources.calls_tokens_usd.next_discriminator: Add provider-reconciled aggregate hard stops across every LLM, API, scheduler and laboratory/tool service.
resources.calls_tokens_usd.residual: Per-call output limits are not calls/input tokens/USD budgets and may omit tool/service costs.

resources.retry_network.cause: Native code performs network searches, provider/service/API calls, package installs, optional posting, retries and possible remote job submission without a frozen endpoint allowlist or global retry ceiling.
resources.retry_network.next_discriminator: Preinstall offline dependencies, forbid asynchronous remote jobs and posting, and bind a deny-by-default endpoint/DNS/TLS/retry policy.
resources.retry_network.residual: --dry-run prevents posting only; it does not disable investigation network access, provider calls, skill retries or dynamic installation.

resources.wallclock.cause: V4 supplies an outer process-group watchdog for one future foreground scienceclaw-post invocation.
resources.wallclock.next_discriminator: Demonstrate timeout and cleanup only after isolated execution, task/tool selection and deny-by-default network bindings close.
resources.wallclock.residual: The current registry still refuses with 16 blockers; process termination cannot cancel undeclared remote jobs, which are therefore forbidden rather than treated as bounded.

rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.cause: No content-addressed image/SBOM or publication/retention disposition exists for drafts, artifacts, journals, graphs, attestations, model outputs, figures, code or service-derived content.
rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.next_discriminator: Freeze the complete image/SBOM/notices and a generated-artifact custody, retention and redistribution policy.
rights.container_and_generated_artifacts.residual: Root source rights do not close dependency, container, generated-output or third-party-content rights.

rights.model_provider_and_services.cause: No selected LLM/provider, Infinite, scientific API, database, search, scheduler or laboratory-service terms and data-processing dispositions are bound.
rights.model_provider_and_services.next_discriminator: Bind exact service terms and data/output rights for every selected role and forbid unlisted services.
rights.model_provider_and_services.residual: Public endpoints and API examples are not authorization for matched evaluation use or redistribution.

rights.task_and_benchmark_content.cause: The repository contains 334 skill directories but only four nested component licence files; external datasets, papers, database results and one P5 case are unselected. Public prior-result prefixes are not fresh benchmark authority.
rights.task_and_benchmark_content.next_discriminator: Select a minimal rights-cleared skill/content set and exact candidate-visible/protected-case receipts.
rights.task_and_benchmark_content.residual: Root Apache source licensing does not by itself establish reuse rights for all fetched content, databases, services or protected evaluation material.

runtime.compute.cause: Selected skills can use subprocesses, local code, GPUs, HPC/schedulers or external services; no aggregate CPU, RAM, GPU, PID, disk, parallelism or remote-work cap is frozen.
runtime.compute.next_discriminator: Bind cgroup/disk/PID/GPU limits and prohibit remote/asynchronous execution unless separately metered and cancelable.
runtime.compute.residual: psutil detection and per-tool defaults are observations, not hard enforcement.

runtime.container_or_environment.cause: No digest-pinned base image, OS package set, Python build, architecture, tool binary set, credential surface or complete SBOM is frozen.
runtime.container_or_environment.next_discriminator: Build a filtered, offline, content-addressed environment from a resolved lock and freeze every tool binary and credential mount.
runtime.container_or_environment.residual: The installer clones/pulls mutable source and resolves network packages at run time.

runtime.dependency_lock.cause: No common lockfile exists; core/full requirements have 9/112 declarations and zero exact pins; the 60-key lazy map names 96 unversioned packages and continues after installation failures.
runtime.dependency_lock.next_discriminator: Resolve one platform-specific hash-complete lock for the exact selected skill set and reproduce an offline fail-fast install.
runtime.dependency_lock.residual: A hashed declaration list does not identify resolved transitive artifacts or prove that all selected skills installed successfully.

runtime.task_environment.cause: Agent profile, topic-to-case adapter, exact skills, tool parameters, data revisions, seeds, memory/artifact reset, dry-run draft path and service revisions are unbound.
runtime.task_environment.next_discriminator: Freeze one complete profile/topic/skill/tool/data/reset manifest and exclude source-bundled prior outcomes before candidate access.
runtime.task_environment.residual: ScienceClaw selection and fallback behavior can change the executed scientific workflow for the same topic.
